figurative_meaning_en: A person who sticks persistently and doesn't let go
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোর পিছনে ফেউ লেগেছে, সে কখনো ছাড়বে না।
এই ফেউ-এর মতো লোকের সাথে থাকলে কাজ হবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: You've got a leech on your tail; he won't leave you alone.
Dealing with someone who sticks like a leech is exhausting.
note: Refers to the blood-sucking leech common in Bengal's wetlands, symbolizing unwanted attachment.
